reviewer: codex-institutional-build (engineering self-review; no human/institutional approval implied)

acceptance.criterion: Write an ADR and role/action matrix covering lab membership, project participation, dataset placement, discovery, source evidence, fixed-release sharing, grant expiry, principal disablement and stewardship transfer.
Define link-versus-authority behavior, independent versus membership-derived grants and last-steward recovery without rewriting scientific identities.
acceptance.evidence: ADR 001 placement/link boundaries, ADR 002 grant lineage, ADR 003 last-steward recovery

acceptance.criterion: Specify public API and migration examples for existing datasets/curators; keep proposals clear where institution-specific inputs are outstanding.
acceptance.evidence: ADR 001 resource/API table and ADR 003 legacy migration example; SITE01-dependent choices explicitly open

crossContractReview: One primary project and explicit inheritance controls agree across organization, policy and migration.
Project/lab administration never supplies an implicit restricted dataset or source-evidence bypass.
Migration preserves existing principal IDs, revoked credentials, fixed-release scopes and historical attribution.
Full principal disablement overrides all access and remains possible for the last steward.
Current authority remains separate from immutable releases, stored receipts and provenance.
Atomic generations/idempotency and independent-policy recovery obligations have identified implementation owners.
limits: Design gate only; F02/F03/F04 organization and authority runtime is not implemented by these ADRs.
SITE01 institution/provider/approver names are still unknown.
Independent access review, provider qualification, screen-reader adoption and operator recovery remain open.
